thread:
deploy-bot: [AUTO-ROLLBACK] Release 4.1.5 -> rolling back to 4.1.4. Trigger: p95 latency > 1100ms for 5m + error-rate 3.8%. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/rollback.

rhea: Saw the alert. Canary failures are concentrated on /v1/embeddings endpoints.

tom: Confirmed. Stack traces show a new validation error in the request sanitizer introduced in 4.1.5.

ops-oncall: Auto-rollback in progress. Suggest we pause if someone needs a quick check: `deployctl rollback hold --id=4.1.5-auto`.

rhea: Please hold for 2m. I'll grep logs for the sanitizer exception across fleets.

ana: Heads-up: 4.1.5 included a change to strict JSON decode that can surface on older SDK clients. Might be client-plus-server mismatch.

ops-oncall: Holding auto-rollback now. `deployctl rollback hold --id=4.1.5-auto --reason="triage SDK mismatch"`.

tom: Logs: `ValidationError: unknown_field: model_hints`. That field was added conditionally in 4.1.5. Older SDKs send it differently.

rhea: Given this, promoting 4.1.4 seems safer than forcing a client rollout. Recommend manual promote.

ops-oncall: Ready to promote. Command: `deployctl promote --service=api-gateway --to-version=4.1.4 --force --wait`. Confirm?

ana: Also pin hosted pools to 4.1.4: `redwoodctl pin --env=prod --version=4.1.4 --scope=hosted` so we don't auto-retry.

ops-oncall: Executing pin and promote now.

deploy-bot: Promote started. Rolling traffic back to 4.1.4.

rhea: Watching p50/p95 and 5xx. p95 dropping, errors decreasing.

tom: I'll open INF-1350 for the sanitizer change and call out SDK compatibility.

ana: Drafting customer-facing blurb: "We reverted 4.1.5 due to increased errors for some clients. Restored 4.1.4. Investigation underway; we'll share an update within 24 hours."

ops-oncall: Promote complete. Traffic at 100% -> 4.1.4. Health checks green.

sre-rotation-bot: Reminder: oncall handover in 40m. Include this rollback and INF-1350 in your notes.

rhea: Adding traces and a minimal repro to the ticket. Will coordinate SDK team for a client-safe fix.

ops-oncall: Closing auto-rollback thread; keeping monitors at 15m.

tom: Can we schedule a blocked reattempt until SDK compat tests pass?

ana: I'll add smoke-tests to the pre-release checklist and block re-rolls until verified.

rhea: customer note posted to status and internal #incidents. Closing thread after handover updated.
